title: Star City Speech for Parents - Videos
description:
Welcome to Star City Speech for Parents!

Hi, I’m Kirsten — a pediatric Speech-Language Pathologist passionate about helping you support your child’s communication journey. This channel is designed to empower parents with practical, easy-to-use strategies to build speech and language skills right at home — especially for children with speech delays, language delays, or early communication challenges.

Whether you're just starting to notice speech delays or have been navigating speech therapy for years, you’ll find helpful tips, activities, and expert guidance right here.

✨ Looking for videos made just for kids? Check out @starcityspeech for fun, kid-friendly speech therapy content!

Have questions about your child’s speech or language? Drop a comment — I’d love to hear from you!
